Method of Attack: File-encrypting ransomware targeting corporate networks and enterprises
Ransomware attacks focusing on encrypting systems and demanding ransom payments
Impacted Systems: Enterprises such as Norsk Hydro and Prosegur
Swiss small, medium-sized, and large companies
Attack Vector: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) with weak passwords and default ports
Malware infections such as Emotet and TrickBot
Ignored antivirus warnings and notifications from authorities
Lack of offline backups and patch management
No network segmentation and excessive user rights
Indicators of Compromise: Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and command and control (C2) infrastructure associated with MegaCortex and LockerGoga
Encrypted systems and ransom demands ranging from thousands to millions of Swiss Francs
